author: Kevin Stratvert
description:
New to Confluence? In this quick tutorial, I’ll show you how to get started fast.

Confluence is a powerful collaboration tool where teams brainstorm ideas, build documents, share knowledge, and publish polished pages — all in one place. You can start on a whiteboard, collaborate in real time, and even use built-in AI to generate outlines, summarize content, and kick-start your work.

If you’re searching for a Confluence tutorial for beginners or want a simple walkthrough to understand how it works, this is for you.

👉 Try Confluence for free (up to 10 users): https://confluence.kevinstratvert.com
👉 Watch the full step-by-step Confluence tutorial here:
https://youtu.be/t7WC-pv1Qkw

title: Confluence Tutorial for Beginners – How to Get Started Fast
